title: Toddler Marcelle Next to Classical Statue, 1967 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black and white snapshot taken in April 1967 showing an eleven-month-old toddler girl named Marcelle standing outdoors in a garden setting. She reaches toward a classical-style statue of a draped female figure holding an ornament aloft. Potted succulents, including jade plants, are seen in the foreground against a wooden fence.
